name: Anna Warrington
occupation: Retired team lead and project manager

bio.statement: Warrington's pamphlet statement lists prior governmental experience as North Plains City Councilor 2026 and calls herself an appointed councilor.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: North Plains City Councilor 2026

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-24)

bio.statement: She says she has been a North Plains resident for two decades and is a retired team lead and project manager.
bio.excerpt: As a North Plains resident for two decades and a retired Team Lead and Project Manager, I am proud to serve as your appointed City Councilor.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-24)

positions.statement: Warrington's pamphlet statement says her focus is on constant, high-quality development over rapid expansion that reflects what residents want.
positions.excerpt: My focus is on constant, high-quality development over rapid expansion that reflects what North Plains residents want.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-24)

positions.statement: Her pamphlet statement says she is focused on Urban Renewal Agency funding that can help local businesses thrive.
positions.excerpt: I’m focused on our Urban Renewal Agency fundings that can help our local businesses thrive.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-24)

positions.statement: Her pamphlet statement calls addressing overdue city audits her top priority and says she will keep working on remaining reports until current.
positions.excerpt: Addressing overdue audits is our top priority.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-24)
